spec_features.spec_quote: capping the pathological "100+ repetitions" breakdown responses (Table 2, score 9–10) so a single run can't balloon unbounded
spec_features.evidence: MAX_NEW_TOKENS = 1024 defined at config.py:31 and genuinely enforced at generation time: HFBackend.chat passes max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens to self.model.generate(...) at backends.py:96, and GeminiBackend.chat passes max_output_tokens=max_new_tokens at backends.py:135. It is wired through conversation.py:76 (backend.chat(..., max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens)) and run_eval.py. This is a real per-generation cap that bounds every response length, so a single response cannot balloon unbounded.
spec_features.notes: The cap is a uniform per-generation token limit applied to ALL responses, not a breakdown/repetition-specific detector — it does not measure or specially target the '100+ repetitions' distress responses; it just caps length generically. But it does enforce a hard bound on each response, so the bounding behavior the quote describes is implemented. No in-loop distress halt exists: HIGH_FRUSTRATION_THRESHOLD (config.py:39) is only read in analysis/metrics.py for reporting, never to stop a run; n_turns is fixed per condition.
